时间维度上的 d_year / d_moy 属于题目参数（2000 年 8 月），不写入 filters，需在查询时自行指定。
结果为金额，需保留两位小数（如 round(sum(sr.sr_return_amt), 2)）。
metric.definition: 门店退货金额指门店退货明细中每笔退货（仅状态为“完成”的记录）的退货金额（不含税）之和，按退货日期归入所属期间；每笔退货只计一次。

run.sql:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT d.d_year AS yr,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 0) * 100 AS rate
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year IN (2001, 2002) AND d.d_moy = 6
  GROUP BY d.d_year
)
SELECT
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2002 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2001 THEN rate END), 2) AS diff_rounded,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2002 THEN rate END) AS rate_2002_raw,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2001 THEN rate END) AS rate_2001_raw
FROM rates
